method: Priority file bytes were hashed and scanned only for study_uid key/value pairs. No clinical target/state/evidence/trigger value was parsed, selected, displayed or used. The first100 ordered UIDs were checked against both previous50-source bone packets. This process-level priority-file access is disclosed and does not imply first-ever blindness.
